newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOSTEM SHARES FALL ON EXPECTED BUSINESS SLOWDOWN.
newsitem.headline: TOSTEM SHARES FALL ON EXPECTED BUSINESS SLOWDOWN.

text.p: Shares of Tostem Corp fell on Thursday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange for four days in a row due to expectations that the company's business may slow down, traders said.
By 0119 GMT, Tostem shares fell 50 yen at 2,320 yen.
Tostem is a maker of aluminium housing materials.
"The company's shares have been sold for some time due to expectations that its earnings may shrink," a trader at a foreign brokerage said.
Tostem shares hit a 1997 high of 3,280 yen on June 25 and their current price is nearly 30 percent below that level, exceeding the average decline in share prices on the TSE, the trader said.
